memory.metric: sum of macOS process physical footprints
memory.guard_metric: Larger of summed RSS and summed physical footprints; RSS can double-count shared pages.
memory.scope: Evaluator and its child processes (optional visual reviewer or Laya, camera browser including GPU/helpers, Node, simulator/PX4/MAVSDK) plus the app/Qwen process tree. Excludes unrelated applications and user browser tabs. Sampling is not an OS-enforced RAM limit.
